blocking_findings.title: Causal phase-locked intervention is not reproducibly schedulable
evidence: GF_T_PHASE_LOCKED_PACKET requires a causal upward zero crossing of a 0.3-1.5 Hz filtered signal, a registered phase offset, and subtraction of calibrated causal-filter delay.
The only fully specified 0.3-1.5 Hz filter in the observation contract is a fourth-order zero-phase scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt filter, which is noncausal.

No causal filter design or coefficients, online state initialization, transient rule, numeric or algorithmic delay calibration, phase-to-time conversion, reference period/frequency, or event-collision rule is frozen.
Negative offsets cannot be scheduled after a newly detected crossing unless a previous-cycle or next-cycle wrapping rule is frozen.
blocking_findings.impact: Primary T6, secondary T7, their Level-A trajectories and estimands, and downstream cross-target and C2 evaluations admit materially different implementations.
required_v2_correction: Freeze the exact causal filter algorithm, order, coefficients, sampling rate, state initialization, warmup and edge behavior.
Freeze an exact delay-calibration algorithm or constant and how it is applied.
Freeze phase-reference and phase-to-time conversion, including the reference period/frequency.
Freeze negative-offset wrapping, first eligible cycle, refractory behavior, overlapping-packet behavior, and missed-trigger behavior.

blocking_findings.title: T8 windowing contradicts the common analysis edge rule and lacks an executable spectral estimator
evidence: The analysis interval is 180 seconds and the common observation contract excludes 10 seconds at each side, leaving 160 retained seconds.
T8 requires six nonoverlapping 30-second windows, which requires 180 seconds, with no explicit exception or window placement rule.

Every T8 window requires a dominant SO peak, but the only frozen Welch settings use nperseg=12000 at 200 Hz, a 60-second segment that cannot be applied to a 30-second window without an implicit parameter change.
blocking_findings.impact: T8 occupancy and persistence are undefined; the mandatory complete eight-target and 8-by-8 off-target evaluation cannot be executed reproducibly.
required_v2_correction: Freeze exact T8 window start and stop times and state explicitly whether the common edge exclusion applies or has a target-specific prospective exception.
Freeze a window-compatible spectral estimator, including segment length, overlap, FFT length, detrending, band, tie, and peak-refinement rules.
Reconcile T8 denominators and persistence rules with the resulting number and duration of valid windows.

blocking_findings.title: T7 Level-A decision rule requires conditions absent from its frozen grid
evidence: The shared T6/T7 Level-A phase grid is [-pi,-2pi/3,-pi/3,0,pi/3,2pi/3,pi].
The T7 effect estimand and practical margin require observed-output separation at requested -pi/2 versus +pi/2.
Neither -pi/2 nor +pi/2 is a Level-A condition. Their appearance in a conditional Level-B surface cannot repair the Level-A pass rule because Level-B eligibility is decided only after Level A.
blocking_findings.impact: The secondary T7 effect estimand and pass/fail decision cannot be computed from the prescribed Level-A observations.
blocking_findings.required_v2_correction: Prospectively add the required -pi/2 and +pi/2 Level-A conditions or redefine the T7 estimand and margin to exact conditions that are present, then reconcile run counts and compute budget.

blocking_findings.title: Required simultaneous confidence intervals lack a frozen construction and family
evidence: Phase2A defines a paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap and a two-sided 95 percent interval.
Level-B eligibility, negligible/trade-off labels, non-target vetoes, T1, and formal gates require simultaneous 95 percent intervals or bounds.
The artifacts do not freeze the simultaneous family, joint statistic, multiplicity-adjusted quantile, max-type/bootstrap construction, or circular-endpoint handling.
blocking_findings.impact: Eligibility, off-target vetoes, and some efficacy decisions can change with implementation-selected confidence-family definitions.
blocking_findings.required_v2_correction: Freeze each simultaneous-inference family and the exact reproducible construction, including resampling unit, joint statistic or adjusted quantile, sidedness, endpoint set, seed, and circular handling.

blocking_findings.title: T4 pulse-replica veto uses an undefined added-event classifier
evidence: T4 requires at least one autonomous sigma cycle after packet offset in at least 50 percent of added events.
No event-level counterfactual matching, packet-association window, overlap resolution, or operational definition of added event is frozen.
blocking_findings.impact: A hard primary-target failure rule cannot be evaluated consistently under paired sham and intervention trajectories.
blocking_findings.required_v2_correction: Freeze the deterministic event-matching or event-attribution algorithm, packet-association window, overlap and tie rules, denominator, and treatment of unmatched sham and intervention events.

nonblocking_findings.title: Circular grid contains duplicate-equivalent endpoints
nonblocking_findings.detail: The T6/T7 grid contains both -pi and +pi, which are the same circular phase. V2 should define canonicalization, whether both are deliberately replicated, and how they count in summaries and compute accounting.

nonblocking_findings.title: Freeze manifest sequences independent audit after executable preflight
nonblocking_findings.detail: This receipt is a specification-level outcome-blind audit performed before code inspection. A later exact-code and data-free preflight audit remains mandatory after a corrected protocol version passes its own freeze audit.

nonblocking_findings.title: Compute fit is arithmetic and envelope-level only
nonblocking_findings.detail: The budget, reserve, process, storage, stop, and checkpoint rules fit on paper, but empirical runtime and memory fit cannot be certified until corrected specifications are implemented, code-frozen, and exercised only in a data-free preflight.
